name: binostat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = binostat(10, 0.3); [m_v, v_v] = binostat([5 10 20], 0.5); [m_b, v_b] = binostat(10, [0.1 0.5 0.9]); [m_p0, v_p0] = binostat(10, 0); [m_p1, v_p1] = binostat(10, 1); [m_n0, v_n0] = binostat(0, 0.5); m_neg = binostat(-1, 0.5); m_pneg = binostat(10, -0.1); m_pover = binostat(10, 1.5); m_frac = binostat(2.5, 0.5);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = binostat(n, p). Binomial: m=n·p, v=n·p·(1-p). Vectorised. n<0 / non-integer / p<0 / p>1 => NaN. p∈{0,1} are valid (variance becomes 0).
